name: Newcastle
meta_description: Newcastle's beer guide: Ouseburn breweries, historic Quayside pubs and bookable brewery tours and tastings across the city.
intro_md:
Newcastle gave its name to one of the world's most travelled beers, but the city's drinking culture runs far deeper than the famous brown ale. Head east from the Quayside into the Ouseburn Valley and you'll find a proper beer quarter, where Brinkburn St Brewery pours its own craft beers and the Free Trade Inn serves a well-kept pint with a famous view of the Tyne bridges.

In the city centre, the Crown Posada is a slender Victorian treasure of stained glass and dark wood, while Blackfriars — a restored medieval friary — now brews its own beer at St Dominic's micro-brewery. Wylam Brewery, in the Palace of Arts in Exhibition Park, opens its taproom in grand surroundings.

For food, the Grainger Market is the place for a stottie and a browse.

**Don't miss**

- The view from the Free Trade Inn in Ouseburn
- A pint under the stained glass at the Crown Posada
- Wylam Brewery's taproom in Exhibition Park

gyg_tours.title: Brinkburn St. Brewery: Brewery Tour and Beer Tasting
gyg_tours.summary: A two-hour small-group tour of Brinkburn St Brewery in Newcastle's Ouseburn area, with tastings of the brewery's own craft beers, from session ales to IPAs and stouts.
gyg_tours.description_md: Explore the behind-the-scenes workings of Brinkburn St. Brewery, a microbrewery in Newcastle upon Tyne. On this tour you learn about the brewing process and the history of the brewery while taking in its eclectic space filled with local Northern artwork and collectibles. You then sample a range of original craft beers, many brewed on-site, spanning session ales, bold IPAs and rich stouts.
highlights: Guided tour of a working microbrewery
Learn about the brewing process and history
Taste a range of original craft beers
Session ales, IPAs and stouts to sample
Access to the Tap Room Restaurant
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Brinkburn St. Brewery, Newcastle upon Tyne

gyg_tours.title: Newcastle: Brewery Tour, Lunch, and Beer Tasting
gyg_tours.summary: A tour of St Dominic's micro-brewery at Blackfriars, a former Dominican friary dating from 1239, followed by a three-course lunch, a flight of beers and a beer gift pack to take home.
gyg_tours.description_md: Explore St Dominic's micro-brewery, housed within Blackfriars Restaurant in a Dominican friary dating back to 1239. Your guide shares the history of the brewery and the friary before the friars' expulsion by King Henry VIII in 1536. The experience combines a three-course lunch made from fresh, local and seasonal produce with a tasting of beers brewed on site, plus a beer gift pack to take away.
highlights: Explore St Dominic's micro-brewery in a 1239 friary
Learn the brewery and friary's history
Three-course lunch from local seasonal produce
Flight of 3 beers brewed on site
Beer gift pack with three 500ml bottles
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Parlour Bar at Blackfriars Restaurant, Newcastle, where the guide meets you on arrival.

gyg_tours.title: Newcastle: 3-Course Meal with Beer Flight
gyg_tours.summary: A three-course meal at Dobson & Parnell on Newcastle's Quayside, paired with a flight of three artisan beers brewed at St Dominic's Brewery.
gyg_tours.description_md: Enjoy a three-course meal paired with a beer flight at Dobson & Parnell, an award-winning restaurant set in a Grade I listed Victorian building on Newcastle's Quayside. The menu features contemporary British and European dishes made with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients. Each course is accompanied by a flight of three artisan beers brewed at St Dominic's Brewery.
highlights: Beers brewed at St Dominic's Brewery
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Dobson & Parnell restaurant, Newcastle Quayside; wait to be greeted and seated at the podium next to the restaurant entrance.
